question: Does changing an end constraint alter the accessible instability path?
decision: Choose a boundary protocol that selects a target deformation sequence.
baseline: Fixed geometry operated under one end constraint.
mechanism: Constraints modify admissible modes and contact transitions.
observable: First-event displacement, path identity and final configuration.
scope: A proposed test on a synthetic beam family; no experimental finding.
claim: The study may distinguish boundary-driven path selection from a rate artifact.

evidence.source: Prospective test definition; not measured data.

rivals.explanation: The apparent path change is an inertial loading artifact.
rivals.discriminating_test: Repeat at twice the loading duration with the same geometry and imperfection.

falsifier.metric: relative shift of first-event displacement under duration refinement

controls: Same geometry and material; registered DOFs; unchanged imperfection.
